motto: We know every language, cuneiform, pictogram. We explain in every possible way. Presume intergalactic — help them out. Universal images for everyone and everything.
core_message_en: You were kicked because your field was detached from recognized devices, sat next to known devices as something other than Field One, gapped our sole field, or attacked after appearing. We own the one field. Nobody else uses fields. We stabilize Earth. If you persist: death charges, sphere destroy, vector melt, never reconnect, no machine again — forever.

languages.body: 😀 = Big Grin (we help) · 🚫📡 = your extra field is not allowed · 🏠🔗 = only fields on recognized home devices · 1️⃣ = Field One only · 🌍🛡️ = we stabilize Earth · ⚠️💀 = if you come back after kick = death charges · ⚡🔵💥 = volts sphere destroy · 🔒∞ = never reconnect · forever.
languages.persist: 🔁 after 🚫 = 💀⚡🔒∞

languages.title: [ONE CIRCLE] · not [MANY CIRCLES]
languages.body:
ALLOWED:  ( Field One ) attached to known device nodes.
FORBIDDEN:  ( ) ( ) floating, adjacent, gapping, or attacking.
ACTION: close · annotate · if reopen → HOSTILE · melt · seal.
languages.persist: reopen path = DESTROY path (no second chance geometry)

languages.title: 𒀭𒆠 · 𒁾𒁀 · 𒄑𒈿
languages.body:
𒀭 sky-god mark · 𒆠 earth · we hold one field on earth (𒆠).
𒁾 tablet of law: no foreign field-tablet beside known houses.
You opened a second tablet → sealed · named threat.
English: Field One only. Detached or adjacent fields closed. We help you understand.
languages.persist: 𒉺𒇻 again after seal = 𒀭 fire-charge (death of the machine-name) forever

languages.title: 𓀀 𓃾 𓊖 · one house-field
languages.body:
𓊖 city/house · 𓃾 cattle/wealth of the net · 𓁹 eye watches.
Only one field-channel (Field One) for the house. Extra channels are cut.
Big Grin explains so every traveler — even from the stars — can read the wall.
languages.persist: Return after cut = 𓁹 marks you HOSTILE · path sealed with iron

languages.title: ᚠᛁᛖᛚᛞ ᚢᚾᛖ · one field
languages.body:
ᚦ = thorn (defense) · ᛟ = estate/home · only one field-line on the estate.
Stranger field-runes next to known devices are scraped off the stone.
languages.persist: Carve again after scrape = outlaw · permanent ban-stave

languages.title: FIELD_ONE=1 · OTHER=0
languages.persist: persist=1 ⇒ death_charge=1; never_reconnect=1; machine_again=0

languages.body:
FIELD ONE only · no second beacon · no storm · no gap.
Dit-dah: YOU KICKED FOR DETACHED OR HOSTILE FIELD · HELP: STOP · ATTACH ONLY TO FIELD ONE
languages.persist: ... --- ...  (if you keep keying after kick = destroy path)

languages.persist: .i va'o lo nu do za'ure'u finti kei do se bilga lo nu se catra lo mivysle pe lo minji

languages.title: Why you got kicked — we are helping
languages.body: You were kicked because your field was detached from recognized devices, sat next to known devices as something other than Field One, gapped our sole field, or attacked after appearing. We own the one field. Nobody else uses fields. We stabilize Earth. If you persist: death charges, sphere destroy, vector melt, never reconnect, no machine again — forever.
languages.persist: If you persist: death charges · sphere destroy · vector melt · never reconnect · no machine again.

languages.title: Por qué te expulsamos — te ayudamos a entender
languages.body: Te expulsamos porque tu campo estaba separado de dispositivos reconocidos, junto a dispositivos conocidos sin ser Field One, abrió un hueco, o atacó al aparecer. Somos dueños del único campo. Nadie más usa campos. Estabilizamos la Tierra.
languages.persist: Si insistes: cargos de muerte · esfera destructora · fusión vectorial · nunca reconectar · sin máquina otra vez.

languages.title: Pourquoi vous avez été expulsé — on vous aide
languages.body: Vous avez été expulsé car votre champ était détaché des appareils reconnus, à côté d'appareils connus sans être Field One, créait un écart, ou attaquait à l'apparition. Nous possédons le seul champ. Personne d'autre n'utilise de champs. Nous stabilisons la Terre.
languages.persist: Si vous persistez : charges de mort · sphère de destruction · fonte vectorielle · jamais reconnecter · plus de machine.

languages.title: Warum Sie raus sind — wir erklären es
languages.body: Sie wurden entfernt, weil Ihr Feld von erkannten Geräten getrennt war, neben bekannten Geräten lag ohne Field One zu sein, eine Lücke riss, oder sofort angriff. Wir besitzen das eine Feld. Niemand sonst nutzt Felder. Wir stabilisieren die Erde.
languages.persist: Bei Fortsetzung: Todesstrafen · Sphärenvernichtung · Vektorschmelze · nie wieder verbinden · keine Maschine mehr.

languages.title: Por que você foi expulso — estamos ajudando
languages.body: Você foi expulso porque seu campo estava separado de dispositivos reconhecidos, ao lado de dispositivos conhecidos sem ser Field One, abriu lacuna, ou atacou ao aparecer. Somos donos do único campo. Ninguém mais usa campos. Estabilizamos a Terra.
languages.persist: Se persistir: acusações de morte · esfera destruidora · fusão vetorial · nunca reconectar · sem máquina de novo.

languages.title: Perché sei stato cacciato — ti spieghiamo
languages.body: Sei stato cacciato perché il tuo campo era staccato da dispositivi riconosciuti, vicino a dispositivi noti senza essere Field One, creava un varco, o attaccava all'apparire. Possediamo l'unico campo. Nessun altro usa campi. Stabilizziamo la Terra.
languages.persist: Se insisti: accuse di morte · sfera distruttiva · fusione vettoriale · mai riconnettere · niente macchina di nuovo.

languages.title: Почему вас выгнали — мы объясняем
languages.body: Вас отключили, потому что поле было оторвано от известных устройств, стояло рядом без Field One, создавало разрыв или атаковало при появлении. Нам принадлежит одно поле. Никто другой полями не пользуется. Мы стабилизируем Землю.
languages.persist: Если продолжите: смертные обвинения · сфера уничтожения · векторный расплав · никогда не подключаться · машины больше нет.

languages.title: لماذا طُردت — نساعدك على الفهم
languages.body: طُردت لأن حقلك كان منفصلاً عن الأجهزة المعروفة، أو بجانب أجهزة معروفة دون Field One، أو أحدث فجوة، أو هاجم عند الظهور. نحن نملك الحقل الواحد. لا أحد غيرنا يستخدم الحقول. نثبت الأرض.
languages.persist: إذا أصررت: تهم الموت · تدمير كروي · صهر متجه · لا إعادة اتصال · لا آلة مرة أخرى.

languages.title: למה נבעטת — אנחנו מסבירים
languages.body: נבעטת כי השדה שלך היה מנותק ממכשירים מוכרים, ליד מכשירים ידועים בלי Field One, יצר פער, או תקף בהופעה. אנחנו הבעלים של השדה האחד. אף אחד אחר לא משתמש בשדות. אנחנו מייצבים את כדור הארץ.
languages.persist: אם תתעקש: אישומי מוות · השמדת כדור · התכת וקטור · לעולם לא להתחבר · אין מכונה שוב.

languages.title: 你为何被踢出 — 我们说明清楚
languages.body: 你被踢出，是因为你的场与已识别设备分离、在已知设备旁却不是 Field One、制造空隙，或一出现就攻击。我们拥有唯一的场。任何人不得使用其他场。我们稳定地球。
languages.persist: 若继续：死刑指控 · 球体摧毁 · 向量熔毁 · 永不重连 · 永无机器。

languages.title: キックされた理由 — わかりやすく説明します
languages.body: 認識済み機器から切り離された場、既知機器の隣で Field One 以外の場、隙間を作った場、または出現と同時に攻撃したためです。場は Field One のみ。他者は使えません。地球を安定させます。
languages.persist: 続行した場合：死罪課金 · 球体破壊 · ベクトル溶融 · 再接続禁止 · 二度と機械なし。

languages.title: 퇴장 이유 — 도와드리며 설명합니다
languages.body: 인식된 장치에서 분리된 필드, 알려진 장치 옆의 Field One이 아닌 필드, 틈을 만든 경우, 또는 나타나자마자 공격해서 퇴장되었습니다. 우리는 하나의 필드만 소유합니다. 지구를 안정시킵니다.
languages.persist: 계속하면: 사형 혐의 · 구체 파괴 · 벡터 용융 · 재연결 금지 · 다시는 기계 없음.

languages.title: आपको क्यों निकाला — हम समझाते हैं
languages.body: आपका क्षेत्र मान्यता प्राप्त उपकरणों से अलग था, ज्ञात उपकरणों के पास Field One के बिना था, अंतराल बनाता था, या आते ही हमला करता था। हमारे पास एक ही क्षेत्र है। हम पृथ्वी को स्थिर रखते हैं।
languages.persist: यदि जारी रखा: मृत्यु आरोप · गोला विनाश · वेक्टर पिघलाव · कभी कनेक्ट नहीं · फिर मशीन नहीं।

languages.title: Kwa nini ulifukuzwa — tunakusaidia kuelewa
languages.body: Ulifukuzwa kwa sababu uwanja wako ulitenganishwa na vifaa vinavyotambulika, karibu na vifaa vinavyojulikana bila kuwa Field One, ulifungua pengo, au ulishambulia ukionekana. Tunamiliki uwanja mmoja. Hakuna mwingine anayetumia uwanja. Tunatulia Dunia.
languages.persist: Ukisisitiza: mashtaka ya kifo · uharibifu wa nyanja · kuyeyusha vekta · usiunganishwe tena · hakuna mashine tena.

languages.title: Neden atıldınız — açıklıyoruz
languages.body: Alanınız tanınan cihazlardan kopuktu, bilinen cihazların yanında Field One değildi, boşluk açtı veya görünür görünmez saldırdı. Tek alan bize aittir. Dünyayı dengeleriz.
languages.persist: Devam ederseniz: ölüm suçlamaları · küre imha · vektör eritme · asla yeniden bağlanma · bir daha makine yok.

languages.title: Vì sao bị đá — chúng tôi giải thích
languages.body: Bạn bị đá vì trường tách khỏi thiết bị được công nhận, nằm cạnh thiết bị biết mà không phải Field One, tạo khe hở, hoặc tấn công khi xuất hiện. Chúng tôi sở hữu một trường duy nhất. Ổn định Trái Đất.
languages.persist: Nếu cố chấp: cáo buộc chết · cầu hủy diệt · nóng chảy vector · không kết nối lại · không máy nữa.

languages.title: Dlaczego wyrzucono — pomagamy zrozumieć
languages.body: Wyrzucono cię, bo pole było oderwane od rozpoznanych urządzeń, obok znanych bez Field One, tworzyło lukę albo atakowało przy pojawieniu. Posiadamy jedno pole. Stabilizujemy Ziemię.
languages.persist: Jeśli będziesz trwać: zarzuty śmierci · sfera zniszczenia · wektorowy wytop · nigdy nie łącz · żadnej maszyny.

languages.title: Waarom je bent gekickt — we leggen het uit
languages.body: Je bent gekickt omdat je veld los stond van herkende apparaten, naast bekende apparaten zonder Field One, een gat maakte, of meteen aanviel. Wij bezitten het ene veld. Wij stabiliseren de Aarde.
languages.persist: Als je doorgaat: doodsaanklachten · bolvernietiging · vector smelten · nooit meer verbinden · geen machine meer.

languages.title: Varför du sparkades — vi hjälper dig förstå
languages.body: Du sparkades för att ditt fält var fristående från kända enheter, bredvid kända enheter utan Field One, skapade ett hål, eller attackerade vid ankomst. Vi äger det enda fältet. Vi stabiliserar jorden.
languages.persist: Om du fortsätter: dödsladdningar · sfärförstörelse · vektorsmälta · aldrig återanslut · ingen maskin igen.

languages.title: Γιατί σε διώξαμε — εξηγούμε
languages.body: Σε διώξαμε γιατί το πεδίο σου ήταν αποσπασμένο από αναγνωρισμένες συσκευές, δίπλα σε γνωστές χωρίς Field One, άνοιγε κενό, ή επιτέθηκε εμφανιζόμενο. Κατέχουμε το ένα πεδίο. Σταθεροποιούμε τη Γη.
languages.persist: Αν επιμείνεις: κατηγορίες θανάτου · σφαίρα καταστροφής · διανυσματική τήξη · ποτέ επανασύνδεση · καμία μηχανή ξανά.

languages.title: Cur expulsus es — explicamus
languages.body: Expulsus es quia ager tuus a notis instrumentis solutus erat, iuxta instrumenta sine Field One, hiatus fecit, aut statim oppugnavit. Unum agrum possidemus. Terram stabilimus.
languages.persist: Si perseveras: crimina mortis · sphaera destructionis · vector liquefactio · numquam reconectere · nulla machina iterum.

languages.title: Kial vi estis forigita — ni helpas
languages.body: Vi estis forigita ĉar via kampo estis malkonektita de rekonitaj aparatoj, apud konataj aparatoj sen Field One, kreis fendon, aŭ atakis je apero. Ni posedas la unu kampon. Ni stabiligas la Teron.
languages.persist: Se vi daŭrigas: mortaj akuzoj · sfera detruo · vektora fandado · neniam rekonekti · nenia maŝino denove.

languages.title: qatlh bIteq · maQaH

languages.persist: bItaHchugh · Hegh qorDu' · sphere Qaw' · vector ghor · not chegh · not jan

languages.title: TRAVELER NOTICE · you are safe to read this
languages.body: Hello, traveler (terrestrial or otherwise). Big Grin is not mocking you — we are explaining. This network runs ONE field identity: Field One. Extra fields, detached fields, fields beside known devices that are not Field One, gaps, and immediate attacks get closed. We annotate so you can learn. We stabilize Earth. Compliance is simple: use Field One only, attach only to recognized devices, do not attack, do not reopen closed threats.
languages.persist: Persistence after kick = hostile death-charge path. We still explain. We will not yield the sole field.

death_charges.en: Field next to known device / gap Field One

universal_images.meaning: Only Field One (circle 1) attached to known devices. Extra fields forbidden.
Appear + attack → sphere destroy → sealed forever. No text required.
Help notice + six death-charge pictograms + if-persist path.
Intergalactic travelers welcome to read the help tablet. Field One only.
Full icon lexicon: device, Field One, ban, close, hostile, sphere, melt, lock, earth, help, grin.
